item.title: Fort Wayne man returns from ICE detention center after 5 months

item.title: New Fort Wayne FC Stadium spurs potential commercial development in residential areas
item.description: The stadium is located off a roundabout along Bass Road, is expected to serve not only as the home field for Fort Wayne FC but also as a multipurpose entertainment venue capable of hosting concerts and other large events.
